meta.name: caveman-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for all caveman modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /caveman-help, "caveman help", "what caveman commands", "how do I use caveman".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 速查全部模式、技能与命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常记不住可用命令或想了解全部功能
copy.tagline_en: Look up all modes, skills, and commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often forget the available commands or want to see all features

howto.what: 装上后,当被调用时,Claude 会以 caveman 风格一次性显示一张速查卡,列出所有 caveman 模式、技能和命令,不改变当前模式或写入任何文件。
howto.when: 当用户输入“/caveman-help”或“caveman help”等关键词询问 caveman 用法时触发。

say.text: caveman 有哪些模式和命令?
say.note: 列出所有模式、技能和触发词。

howto.what_en: When invoked, Claude displays a one-shot quick-reference card in caveman style, listing all caveman modes, skills, and commands without changing mode or persisting anything.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user types /caveman-help, "caveman help", or similar keyword asking about caveman usage.

say_en.text: What caveman commands do I have?
say_en.note: Lists all modes, skills, and triggers.
